measurement_scope: Real stage078 history-cache finite cohorts on all four ranks. GPU-active interval union and its complement are clipped to the measured service scope. Unrecorded activity is not automatically avoidable idle time; NCCL kernels include rank waiting. Instrumentation overhead excludes these runs from benchmark speed claims. Rank synchronization after profiler initialization and after trace export occurs outside the measured scope; only cohort6 is captured.
